en:
<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of fantasies does Rantaro
have? Honestly, I have no idea...

Mhm, perfect! It looks like you've
finished all your assignments.

Ah...assignments?
What do you mean?

What do I mean? The math book,
Shuichi. You finished all of it!
<CLT=cltMIND>Math book...

<CLT=cltMIND>Could he be...my tutor? He's too
casual to be a regular teacher...

That's why you're my favorite student.
Good job! Good work, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>As he showered me with praise,
he lightly tussled my hair with a smile.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is part of Rantaro's dream...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't break character, or he'll
wake up and feel awful...

<CLT=cltMIND>For now...
I guess I'll just be his student.

R-Rantaro...
I'm not a little kid...

<CLT=cltMIND>Even if this is his fantasy, it still
feels weird to be talked to like that.
..."Rantaro," huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro's tone had changed.
He pulled his hand away, dejected.

Not that long ago...
You were calling me "Big Brother."
Ah, was I?

<CLT=cltMIND>My irritation seeped into my voice. Of course
I didn't know what he was talking about.

Haha...guess I made you
hate me...didn't I, Shuichi?
...Huh?
Look, I get it. I would be upset too.

I've been your tutor for so long,
but now I tell you I'm leaving...
<CLT=cltMIND>Leaving...?

And the fact that I can't even tell you
why doesn't help. I don't blame you.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is he implying...?
He's so serious all of a sudden.

<CLT=cltMIND>How should I respond? I don't
fully understand what's going on...
I know I'm being selfish, Shuichi.

I'm sorry, but I want to shelter you
from danger as much as I can...
What? Danger...?

Haha, whoops, guess I shouldn't
have said that... Forget it.

No, Rantaro, I won't. Not with
that look on your face...

Some teacher I am, huh?
Making you worry about me...

But you don't have to worry about
a thing. Nothing will ever hurt you.

I will protect you. I promise. No one
precious to me will ever get hurt again.

<CLT=cltMIND>Protect me...from what!?
I can't keep up with this fantasy...

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro is an enigma, I suppose
it makes sense that his fantasies are too.
W-Wait, Rantaro!

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't really understand,
but here goes...
That... That hurts me, Rantaro.

Thinking about you carrying this
burden all by yourself hurts me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro is just trying to keep me
safe, but I can't let him go...

Maybe you see me as just a student,
so you don't think I can protect you...

But I don't *want* to be sheltered
and oblivious to everything.
Shuichi...

Rantaro, you're going to quit being my
tutor, right? So I'm not just your student.

I'm your *friend*. You can tell me
anything. I know I can help you.

Haha... Now where'd this
come from?

But...I'm glad you don't hate me.
Now...I can die happy.
...Don't say that.
...I'm joking.
<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't sound like a joke.

<CLT=cltMIND>If he isn't careful, he'll die...
What has Rantaro gotten himself into?

<CLT=cltMIND>In any case...this is his fantasy.
And I'm with him.

Are you sure about this, Shuichi?
You're at the point of no return...

I would never want you to face
it alone, Rantaro...
You've really come into your own.

Haha... Alright, I give up.
I'll tell you everything.

Just...until the end of this lesson,
can we act like nothing's changed?

The time that I've spent as your teacher...
has been such a comfort to me.
Yes. Of course.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll never forget the smile Rantaro gave me.
It was a smile...I had never seen before.
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
